extraction.notes: Reconciliation taken from the Statements of Operations, FFO & CFFO trailing five quarters table (three months ended September 30, 2025 column). The company has no AFFO metric; CFFO does not deduct recurring capex, so recurring capex was taken from the Capital Expenditures narrative ($8.6 million, stated in millions and rounded to 8,600 thousand; scope is total portfolio, not company share). Zero-value lines (prepayment penalties, loss on extinguishment of debt) were omitted. Share count is 239,576,189 units, divided by 1,000 to 239,576.189 thousands; 71,104 / 239,576 = $0.30 and 69,987 / 239,576 = $0.29, matching reported per-share figures. The 9/30/2025 three-month column is the first column on both the trailing-five-quarter and the three/nine-month pages.
